entities.name: Sebastian Vettel
entities.description: Vettel was named Rookie of the Year at the 2008 Autosport Awards. He was awarded the Lorenzo Bandini Trophy in 2009 for his achievements in the 2008 season. He was also awarded the 2009 British Racing Drivers' Club Johnny Wakefield Trophy for setting the fastest race lap of the season on the Silverstone Grand Prix Circuit. In 2010, he was voted German Sportspersonality of the Year and won the Autosport International Racing Driver Award, which he also won in the following three years. He was honoured with the Grands Prix de l'Academie des Sports in January 2012 and the Silbernes Lorbeerblatt in February 2012. He was voted Formula One driver of the year in 2009, 2011 and 2013. He won the DHL Fastest Lap Award in 2009, 2012 and 2013. He was named European Sportsperson of the Year in 2010, 2012 and 2013. He was named the BBC Overseas Sports Personality of the Year in 2013.
